topic.title: Tensor Factorization and Structured Multiway Data
topic.area: Sparsity, Low-Rank Models, and Dimensionality Reduction
topic.overview: Tensors organize data across several interacting axes, such as entities, time, channels, or relations. Low-rank decompositions aim to exploit that structure for compact representation and recovery of missing entries. Different factorization families encode different assumptions, so tensor rank is not a single interchangeable quantity.
topic.whyItMatters: Scalability and statistical reliability must be considered together. A representation can save memory yet remain hard to fit, and a uniform regularizer can miss differences between frequency components or modes.
topic.evolution: The collection includes early factor-analysis and nonnegative-factorization work, then subspace, sparse, and tensor-train methods. Later results sharpen completion guarantees and online algorithms. Recent dual-spectral regularization distinguishes sparsity across frequencies from low rank within them, while tensor networks support graph and explanation applications. These developments refine which structure is preserved rather than simply reducing every dimension equally.
openQuestions: Which rank or sparsity assumptions can be diagnosed from incomplete data?
How can scalable algorithms retain guarantees under noisy and non-Gaussian observations?

papers.title: Guarantees for Alternating Least Squares in Overparameterized Tensor Decompositions
papers.tldr: The paper proves that ALS globally converges with high probability from random initialization when a low-rank third-order tensor is sufficiently overparameterized.

papers.title: Non-Convex Tensor Recovery from Tube-Wise Sensing
papers.tldr: The paper proposes tube-wise tensor sensing and proves exact, linearly convergent recovery using factorized gradient descent with lower sample complexity than existing methods.

papers.title: Online Functional Tensor Decomposition via Continual Learning for Streaming Data Completion
papers.tldr: OFTD combines tensor decomposition, coordinate-based neural representations, and memory replay to complete streaming data while retaining earlier knowledge.

papers.title: Tensor Decomposition Networks for Fast Machine Learning Interatomic Potential Computations
papers.tldr: Tensor Decomposition Networks accelerate interatomic models through low-rank tensor products with bounded rotational equivariance error and competitive empirical performance.

papers.title: An Asymmetric Latent Factorization-of-Tensors Model for Relation Analysis
papers.tldr: ALFT adds constraints between tensor modes to capture relationships shaped by known ordering or topology within entity sets.

papers.title: Asymptotically Fast Clebsch-Gordan Tensor Products with Vector Spherical Harmonics
papers.tldr: A complete Clebsch–Gordan tensor-product algorithm uses vector spherical harmonics to reduce asymptotic computation without dropping interactions.

papers.title: Bayesian Tensor Decomposition with Diffusion Model Prior
papers.tldr: DiffBCP combines Bayesian tensor decomposition with a pretrained diffusion prior to improve reconstruction under missing data and noise.

papers.title: LoPhyDA: Low-Rank Tensor and Physics Gradient Guided Diffusion for Atmospheric Data Assimilation
papers.tldr: LoPhyDA combines low-rank reconstruction and physics-based diffusion guidance to improve atmospheric assimilation where observations are sparse.

papers.title: MTNL: A Unified Modeling Perspective for Enhancing Tensor Network Learning
papers.tldr: MTNL unifies supervised and unsupervised tensor-network learning through network fusion, structure search, and lightweight Bayesian uncertainty estimation.

papers.title: Near-Universal Multiplicative Updates for Nonnegative Einsum Factorization
papers.tldr: NNEinFact fits custom nonnegative tensor contractions from an einsum specification using fast multiplicative updates with stationary-point convergence.

papers.title: Recursive Binding on a Budget: Subspace Carving in Order-$p$ Tensor Memories
papers.tldr: Orthogonal Subspace Carving uses geometric projections to encode deep recursive bindings in a fixed-order tensor with constant memory footprint.

papers.title: Refining Dual Spectral Sparsity in Transformed Tensor Singular Values
papers.tldr: A new tensor regularizer separately controls sparsity across frequencies and low-rank structure within them, with theory and practical optimization.

papers.title: T-GINEE: A Tensor-Based Multilayer Graph Representation Learning
papers.tldr: T-GINEE combines tensor decomposition and statistical estimating equations to learn multilayer graph representations with explicit cross-layer correlations.

papers.title: TN-SHAP-G: Graph-Structured Tensor Network Surrogates for Shapley Values and Interactions
papers.tldr: TN-SHAP-G learns graph-aligned tensor-network surrogates that enable efficient, deterministic Shapley attribution and interaction calculations.
